workflow: Launch and open a local project
initial_state: Clean user profile or existing local project
steps: Launch the Linux app; open a valid local place; try missing malformed and unsupported paths
expected_result: Supported local project loads without account/network access; failures explain recovery and preserve input
limitations: No direct Windows comparison; file behavior bounded by supported formats

workflow: Create save close and reopen a local project
initial_state: Empty workspace or disposable project fixture
steps: Create in user-selected path; edit supported data; save; close; reopen
expected_result: Semantic project data survives save/reopen and failed writes do not damage the last good file
limitations: Format/version coverage must be reported; unknown data cannot be silently discarded

initial_state: Project with nested and repeated-name instances
steps: Select; insert; rename; reparent; duplicate; delete; undo/redo
expected_result: All panes refer to the same stable instance identity and saved tree reflects committed edits
limitations: Undocumented ordering and visual details remain unknown

initial_state: Project with supported classes and typed values
steps: Select instances; inspect; commit valid values; reject invalid values; save/reopen
expected_result: Typed property edits update the shared model and serialize without silent loss
dependencies: Reflection metadata; data model; UI; serializer
limitations: Only explicitly supported class/property pairs may be edited

workflow: Edit analyze and save Luau scripts
initial_state: Project with valid and invalid Luau source fixtures
steps: Edit source; inspect compiler/type/lint feedback; save/reopen; undo
expected_result: Source text is preserved and language diagnostics are distinct from runtime output
dependencies: Code editor; pinned Luau toolchain; project serializer
limitations: Core Luau does not supply Roblox engine APIs

initial_state: Project with supported primitive geometry
steps: Navigate camera; select visible/overlapping parts; transform; save/reopen
expected_result: Supported geometry renders and transforms persist with documented CFrame semantics
limitations: GPU/driver/session matrix required; unsupported renderables remain data-only

initial_state: Project snapshot before a committed edit
steps: Insert/reparent/edit property/transform/script; undo; redo; create branch
expected_result: Undo/redo restores exact model snapshots and new edits invalidate redo
limitations: Native Studio grouping and history limits are unknown

workflow: Run and stop a basic local playtest
initial_state: Disposable local project with deterministic script
steps: Run locally; capture print/warn/error; stop; compare model and file hash
expected_result: Runtime-only state is discarded and saved project is unchanged
dependencies: Luau VM; minimal engine model; output view
limitations: P0 excludes full engine, client/server, network and avatar simulation

workflow: Open and save larger binary and XML projects
initial_state: Versioned public large-file fixtures
steps: Open; inspect; save; reopen representative .rbxl/.rbxlx/.rbxm/.rbxmx files
expected_result: Declared supported data round-trips and time/memory remain within measured budgets
limitations: Only public or generated fixtures; exact version coverage recorded

initial_state: Medium and large supported scenes
steps: Select groups; move/rotate/scale; pivot; snap; save/reopen
expected_result: Transforms preserve instance relationships and meet measured responsiveness limits
limitations: No support claim before per-workload tests

initial_state: Local scripts with breakpoints and deterministic errors
steps: Set breakpoint; step; inspect locals; continue; stop
expected_result: Debugger state and diagnostics identify the corresponding script and line
dependencies: P0 editor; Luau VM; runtime scheduler
limitations: Engine API and scheduler coverage are separate

initial_state: Public or generated asset fixture
steps: Import supported asset; edit metadata; export; reopen
expected_result: Declared asset data is preserved and failures leave source files intact
dependencies: P0 project model; asset codecs; file dialogs
limitations: Supported codecs and asset classes are not selected

initial_state: Deterministic terrain fixture
steps: Load; inspect; edit selected terrain operations; save/reopen
expected_result: Supported terrain operations preserve voxel/material data
limitations: Scope and format coverage remain unknown

initial_state: Small rig and animation fixture
steps: Inspect rig; edit supported keyframes; preview; save/reopen
expected_result: Supported animation values and hierarchy round-trip
dependencies: P0 model; timeline UI; local runtime
limitations: Rig types and preview semantics need contracts

initial_state: Local audio fixture without account data
steps: Import supported audio; inspect; preview; save/reopen
expected_result: Local supported audio references and metadata remain intact
dependencies: P0 model; audio backend; local file access
limitations: Remote audio availability is outside this workflow

initial_state: Clean user profile and crash-safe disposable project
steps: Change preferences; autosave; interrupt a save; recover; reset profile
expected_result: User settings use XDG paths and recovery never silently overwrites project data
limitations: User data paths must be configurable and documented

initial_state: Minimal plugin fixture with declared capabilities
steps: Install or load a local plugin; exercise supported extension points; disable it
expected_result: Supported plugin actions are isolated, visible, and undoable where applicable
limitations: No plugin API or trust boundary selected

initial_state: Disposable test experience and isolated accounts if later required
steps: Join; edit concurrently; reconcile conflicts; disconnect/reconnect
expected_result: Shared edits and conflicts have explicit state and failure handling
limitations: Requires service contracts and technical discovery

initial_state: Disposable test environment
steps: Sign in; access supported services; expire/revoke test session
expected_result: Credentials and remote state are isolated and errors are actionable
dependencies: Linux credential storage; network clients; service adapters
limitations: Do not automate real account actions; no normative research

initial_state: Disposable test experience
steps: Validate; preview changes; publish only after explicit user action
expected_result: Publish result and failures are explicit and never alter local files silently
dependencies: P0 save; authentication; remote service adapters
limitations: External side effects require a separate technical workflow

initial_state: Public or disposable asset fixtures
steps: Resolve/import advanced asset types and preserve references
expected_result: Asset capability and missing-service behavior are documented
dependencies: P1 asset codecs; remote service adapters
limitations: No remote/API assumptions until researched

initial_state: Disposable plugin suite
steps: Exercise declared advanced plugin APIs and failures
expected_result: Supported plugin contract is versioned and does not corrupt project state
dependencies: P1 plugin host; Luau; project model
limitations: Do not claim broad plugin parity

initial_state: Workflow-specific disposable fixtures
steps: Add workflows only after inventory and creator feedback
expected_result: Each added workflow has its own evidence, status, and acceptance check
limitations: Do not infer feature demand from API class count
